text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I managed to secure a spot on the board. 
For me, that's almost too good of a 
result.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I just can't help thinking about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd changed where I made my move, 
or taken a different line, I thought...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I just wondered if big sis or Vivlos 
would've handled this better..."
choice_data_list:
You showed all the results of your hard 
work!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...R-Really? I certainly hope that's the 
case...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I have to believe just a 
little bit more. In the... magnificent me 
inside...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...! Y-You're right. I need to think it 
through and overcome it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I need to build more stamina and 
confidence than ever... All right, early 
mornings starting tomorrow...!
